title: Comprehensive lineage tracing maps the landscape of cell fate decisions in mouse embryogenesis
title_zh: 全面谱系追踪绘制小鼠胚胎发育细胞命运决策景观
abstract: A comprehensive cell fate map of mammalian embryogenesis has remained out of reach given the scale, cellular diversity, and non-deterministic nature of development in utero. Here, we use PEtracer to continuously install heritable genetic marks as development progresses, reconstructing lineage trees that resolve ∼75% of cell divisions across >1.4 million cells from 16 replicate embryos. We pair these trees with deep transcriptional profiling to resolve cell fate biases, restriction timing, progenitor pool sizes, and lineage relationships throughout embryogenesis. Using this quantitative reference, we uncover strikingly reproducible lineage architecture between replicate embryos and chart the lineage dynamics driving fate specification across diverse tissues. Specific biological insights include the progressive restriction of neural crest fate, the relative contributions of distinct mesodermal origins to endothelium, and the dynamics of axial elongation. This work provides a foundation for a quantitative and predictive understanding of mammalian development.
abstract_zh: 在胚胎发育过程中，由于规模大、细胞多样性以及非决定性发育特征，构建完整的哺乳动物胚胎发育细胞命运图一直是难以实现的目标。本文利用PEtracer技术，在发育过程中持续植入可遗传的遗传标记，重建了覆盖超过140万细胞、来自16个重复胚胎的谱系树，解析了约75%的细胞分裂。我们将这些谱系树与深度转录组分析相结合，揭示了细胞命运偏好、限制时机、祖细胞池大小以及整个胚胎发育过程中的谱系关系。基于这一定量参考，我们发现重复胚胎之间谱系结构高度可重复，并绘制了驱动不同组织命运指定的谱系动力学。具体生物学发现包括神经嵴细胞命运的逐步限制、不同中胚层来源对内皮细胞的相对贡献以及轴向延伸的动力学。该研究为对哺乳动物发育进行定量和预测性理解奠定了基础。
